Every requirement maps to planned work or an explicit deferral:

| Source | Requirement | Coverage | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| README | Three courts; one-hour bookings | C: data integrity; E: booking service; G: website | Invalid courts rejected; slots align to hourly starts and last one hour |
| README | A court cannot be booked twice for a slot | A: existing constraint; C: preserve integrity; E: atomic booking | Constraint tests; competing requests produce exactly one booking |
| README | Cancel until two hours before start | F: cancellation; G: website | Exact cutoff allowed; later cancellation refused; slot and member allowance released |
| Your answers | Members sign in with individual club accounts | B: accounts; C: booking ownership; G: website | Sign-in/out works; anonymous access restricted; members cannot modify others’ bookings |
| Your answers | About 80 members | B: account management | Staff can provision individual accounts; 80 is context, not an invented performance target |
| Your answers | Book up to seven days ahead | E: booking service; G: website | Seven-day boundary allowed; later and past starts rejected |
| Your answers | At most two upcoming bookings per member | E: booking service; F: capacity release; G: website | Third booking rejected, including concurrent attempts; cancellation restores allowance |
| Your answers | Keep Django | B–G | Existing Django project extended |
| README | Guest-booking payments later | Explicitly deferred | No payment work in first-version scope |

The plan also records these judgement calls as assumptions:

| Assumption | Work or checkpoint |
|---|---|
| Staff provision accounts and reset credentials; no public signup | B implements; D reviews |
| Server-rendered Django pages | B and G |
| Configurable timezone, initially UTC; hourly slots throughout the day | C, E and G; D reviews the policy |
| Seven-day boundary inclusive; upcoming means strictly future; cancellation permitted exactly two hours before start | E and F boundary tests |
| Retain SQLite with atomic handling of competing requests | C, E and F |
| Members see availability and their own booking details | B and G privacy checks |
| First version demonstrated locally; production deployment excluded | H acceptance checkpoint |

**D** reviews the member shell and slot policy before **G** proceeds. **H** demonstrates the full journey and booking rules. These are ordinary checkpoint tickets; owner approval is not automatically enforced.
